assets.reference: Author-approved Avatar V2, 清线漫画 style. The reference portrait is not redistributed here.
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one square, finished, funny Chinese reaction meme illustration for the owner’s public sticker-skill showcase. Input image 1 is the approved identity AND clear-line cartoon style reference for director Merlin, not an edit target: preserve his recognizable long angular face, generous fluffy black swept hair, rectangular black glasses, small split moustache and short pointed goatee. Translate to expressive approximately three-head-tall cartoon proportions, NOT a realistic portrait. Pure white background. Crisp confident black outlines, elegant flat colors, no grain, no photographic skin. The director wears a black casual jacket over a teal shirt, dark pants and casual sneakers. He is halfway rising from a simple orange director chair, leaning forward with a hilariously determined, slightly unhinged eager smile and tired eyes. One hand raises exactly one index finger to request just one more take; the other holds one black-and-white clapperboard. A small comically large mound of crumpled storyboard pages at his feet implies countless previous takes, no readable writing on the papers or clapperboard. Strong clear silhouette, no limb overlap, all fingers plausible. Keep entire hair, hands, feet, chair and paper pile inside generous 9% canvas margins. At bottom separated from the illustration with clear breathing room, large beautifully typeset bold black simplified Chinese caption EXACTLY "再来亿条" in one line, centered. These four characters are the only visible text; no headings, no labels, no watermark. Make the visual gag legible at thumbnail size. Fresh, charming and witty rather than ugly. This is a single static meme, no panels, no animation sheet.
assets.web_export: Resized from the original 1254px PNG to a 960px white-background JPEG for the README; illustration and caption unchanged.
